targetSet: The 40 paths in MissingIcons.json only; not the final augment registration/effect count.

scope.method: Unity AssetDatabase via CLI, serialized icon fields, GUID/fileID references, enum matches, project code assignments, candidate images and their existing uses.
scope.limitation: No claim about uncommitted artwork on other computers or external folders. Existing VFX/weapon/card art without an explicit mapping is not designated as an augment icon.

consumer.behavior: Image.sprite = augment.icon; Image.enabled = augment.icon != null; real displayName and description remain available in the tooltip.
